svg.title: Timeout designs: Controller reset, nothing to send
svg.text: Timeout designs · Controller reset, nothing to send
A resets in the sixth data byte of its write to B (no STOP) and has nothing to send afterwards.
F = 1 s · Smax = 5 ms · Bhold = 14.9 ms · Tmax = 20 ms · tstuck = 100 ms · treset = 50 ms (assumed) · byte 11.25 µs · main loop 100 µs (assumed)

C: longest wait 75.6 ms, 2 not successful

owns the bus, START to STOP
Time axis logarithmic: x ∝ log(1 + t / 100 µs). A submits at 1 ms; C writes 8 bytes to D every 25 ms. Lanes A to D: one participant each, the thin bar is its busy
Layered: the controller firmware is firmware/txn/txn.c, compiled unchanged. The limits (Smax, Bhold, tstuck, wait after reset, line check, failure mode) follow the spec
and the documented platform capabilities; the bridges do not implement them yet. txn.c has no bus-failure outcome yet: Aborted.
Single timer: model of one supervision timer per transfer (no implementation). Assumed in both designs: a START inside a running transfer cuts it as a bus error (not
Evidence: byte: measured: 9 bit-times at the observed 800 kbit/s; tbuf: measured; treset: assumed, to be measured; loop: assumed main-loop period; c_period: assumed
